observation: When moved from LLM research to clinical MRI, the learner transferred the experiment/knowledge abstraction into questions about incremental metadata value, robustness to missing/inaccurate metadata, model interaction, and downstream collection-cost/clinical-benefit tradeoffs.
interpretation: Evidence of cross-domain systems transfer during the same session. Because the transfer occurred with active tutoring context, it is not yet a delayed unassisted transfer test.
